title: Back Office square-screen visual inspection

scope.evidence: Root-captured native Tauri screenshots; inspected read-only by /root/audit_admin_regressions

limits: Screenshots prove the captured visual state, not every button's behavior, scrolling reachability or uncaptured form/layout.
No app, product-source, native-service or app-data changes by this agent.
This snapshot includes all bo-*.png files and42-backoffice-overview.png that existed at inspection. Additional forms captured later need a follow-up review.

summary.uncapturedForms: Add/edit/detail dialogs not visible in these initial Back Office captures; no form-width PASS claimed.

findings.title: Order receipt buttons are clipped inside the first table column
findings.observation: The receipt buttons end abruptly at the first column's right boundary: the right border is missing and the last receipt-number glyph is at or clipped by that boundary. This repeats down the populated table while adjacent dates/statuses and totals fit.
findings.sourceExplanation: Back Office forces a fixed-layout table, gives the first column8%, hides overflow in table cells, and makes receipt buttons intrinsic auto width. The available column width can be smaller than the full number plus button padding.
findings.impact: Receipt identification and the apparent clickable control boundary are compromised. The button still has a full accessible label/title; no loss of receipt data or click failure is inferred.
findings.recommendation: Reserve enough first-column width for the longest displayed receipt number and button padding, or use a constrained button with deliberate overflow handling. Validate the complete number and focus border at1024×768.
findings.verificationNext: Check7+digit and longer receipt numbers, keyboard focus outline, sidebar expanded/collapsed and actual configured font size; ensure the full identifier is available without an unmarked hard clip.

findings.title: Staff summary truncates the full role names
findings.observation: The six-column summary shows ADMINISTRA... and ATTENDANCE ... rather than Administrators and Attendance only. The suffix distinguishing attendance-only staff is missing.
findings.sourceExplanation: Six equal-width columns put label and count side by side; summary labels force nowrap/ellipsis and have no title attribute in their markup.
findings.impact: Counts are readable, but some role descriptions are not completely visible. Staff row actions and role badges remain visible.
findings.recommendation: Wrap labels or stack label/count; alternatively use a3×2 summary at this container width. Provide the complete role label for sighted mouse/keyboard users.
findings.verificationNext: Verify all six full labels with nonzero counts and larger configured text, without squeezing staff-row controls.
